data.summary:
Result oriented Business Analyst with 9 years of experience driving end-to-end product delivery across the SDLC in BFSI, Mortgage, KYC, AML, Lending, Loan and Investment Banking domains. Proven Expert in acting as a strategic bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex regulatory frameworks into scalable software solutions. Highly Adept in conducting requirement gathering workshop, Managing Agile Backlogs, and writing High Quality BRDs, FRDs. User Stories, and Product backlog Items (PBIs) using JIRA and Azure DevOps.
❖ PwC
Designation: Sr Business Analyst Roles and Responsibilities: • To understand the business stakeholders’ needs, prioritize the needs based on business values and take ownership
of the requirements for BFSI, KYC, AML, and Investment Banking Clients.
Conducting requirement gathering sessions and elicitation through requirement workshops, Interviews, focus Groups analysis, document Analysis, Questionnaires, brainstorming sessions, and Interface analysis, Prototyping and documenting them in form of Business Requirements/User Stories or BRDs/FRDs.
Applying functional and operational knowledge to deal with difficult Stakeholders and finding out solutions for Challenging requirements.
Guiding a team to deliver the requirements and Sprint Planning and to make requirement grooming as well. • Responsible and took complete ownership for preparing User Stories, liaise with key stakeholders to get exact requirements and document exact business needs along with both functional and non-functional requirements in the form of Use Cases, functional specifications, wire frames, workflow diagrams and flow charts.
Discussed with development team regarding the feasibility of requirements along with development and testing teams to ensure requirements are understood and for requirement sizing.
Responsible for sprint team allocation, Product Backlog creation and Sprint Backlog management in terms of Agile methodology through Azure Devops and JIRA.
Oversee and ensure proper implementation by providing functional specifications and acceptance criteria in User requirements and Product Backlog Items.
Worked with development team to groom the requirements and worked with QA/testing team to perform internal testing of requirements to accept them in Bi-weekly sprint demo and understand concerns raised in Sprint Retrospective
Worked in Risk Analysis, Change Management and CAB deliveries (RFC’s), Requirement Priority assessment, Test Cases review, functional Bug/Incident analysis raised by Client, Support to client in UAT, Process specifications including DOD & DOR.
Strong experience in creating Business Process models in Bizagi Modeler, Mockup/Wireframes in Balsamiq and used MS Paint for demonstrations along with MS Visio.
Responsible for techno functional support in co-ordination with development team and provides support to end users through backend data management through basic SQL queries, Solved user issues and queries.
About Projects @ PWC (Investment Banking – KYC AML Periodic Review)
At PWC, worked for a US Investment Bank – KYC AML process which consists of Case management system, Risk Ranking system and Customer Database Management system.
Feb 2022
• All the above systems are used for conducting periodic review for existing clients of the bank where
the KYC/AML is verified and updated as per the risk ranking of the customers.
Case Management system is the primary system where the periodic review is conducted, Risk Ranking system calculates the risk of the bank’s customers and Customer Database Management System is where the customer’s information is available on real time basis.
Mainly involved in various priority requirements from Clients across the world to Introduce and update functionalities of Case Management system while conducting the periodic review of the customers.
❖ IBM India Private Limited, Pune Designation: Sr Business Analyst Roles and Responsibilities: • Requirement Lifecycle Management: Own all phases of requirement gathering for complex BFSI applications, translating ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement Specifications (FRDs).
Apr 2021 – Feb 2022
Agile Product Backlog Ownership: Create, prioritize, and maintain Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps. Actively lead backlog grooming sessions and provide daily updates in Scrum meetings. • Process Modeling & Analysis: Design detailed Process Flow Diagrams and workflow models using visualization tools. Conduct rigorous Gap and Impact Analysis to mitigate project risks before development begins.
Cross -Functional Collaboration: Lead Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for development teams, ensuring a flawless understanding of functional requirements. Provide real-time support during coding and unit testing phases. • Quality Assurance Partnership: Collaborate with QA teams to develop robust test strategies and test plans. Author and review test case scripts and execute SQL queries to validate backend data against business logic.
❖ Amazon India Development Center, Pune
Dec 2018 – Apr 2021
Designation: Sr. Business Analyst Roles and Responsibilities: • Strong experience in understanding Mock-up’s and Business process models and notations (BPMN’s) through Bizagi Modeler and whiteboarding the requirements and preparing custom design solutions. Drive the MVP’s/PBI’s to meet aggressive deadlines.
Part of the engineering team to understand in backlog grooming and Sprint Planning sessions and then work in requirements development for the Sprint and bug fixes before they are released to ensure a high-quality product. • Provides correct Story Pointing to the requirements (MVP’s) through Pointing Poker after understanding the requirement and assisting BA by suggesting possible non-functional requirements as well.
Understand all the possible Use Cases and ensure the acceptance criteria of the requirements met through the development without any regression Bugs
Worked with Business Analysts, Customers, end Users, experience designers, Architects, development leads and testers to remove roadblocks and provide the technical feasibility for the requirements
Provide presentations and demonstrations on Product Features to Client in Sprint Review session and provides constructive feedback in Sprint Retrospective
Preparation and review of Code review, Design review documents and well versed with working on Change Management Process and Change requests. and bug fixes to stakeholders.
❖ Rage Frameworks Pvt Ltd, A Genpact Company, Pune
Oct 2015 – Dec 2018
Designation: Consultant- Business Analyst Roles and Responsibilities: • Involved in all phases of requirement gathering applications. Responsible for system release on System changes. • Liaise between Customers, end Users, experience designers, Architects, development groups and testers to remove roadblocks and foster communication. Provide presentations and demonstrations on Product Features to Product owner and to Steering committee.
• Preparation and review of User requirement documents, Business requirement documents and creation of RFC’s
and Change Management Process
❖ IndusInd Bank Ltd, Pune
June 2014 – Sep 2015
Designation: Relationship Manager. Roles and Responsibilities:
Onboarding new entities and performing their End-to-End KYC. • Ensuring the client’s offshore transactions are complaints as per banking regulations and SWIFT messages. • Visiting the site of clients and investigating the client’s legitimacy before onboarding or while taking high-risk
products. Investigating the suspicious transactions or activity of clients, asking the reasons from the sales team about the same, and documenting the reports.
Educating the sales team about the Trade forex regulation and promoting the products like FCTL, CC, Derivatives, BG, LC, BC etc.
Analyzing the data of 2000 clients and designing the trend of their transactions that helped in predicting the future transactions and identifying the gaps and problems of non-transacting clients.
